youtube.title: Captions that match your approved copy, byte for byte
youtube.description:
What if your ad has a typo? In funkbox every caption comes from one approved copy file. You approve the wording, it is hash-locked, and every render writes a text audit proving each on-screen string matches, byte for byte.

Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
